  1. Work

A slot booking bot for Uzum Market sellers

A Telegram bot that watches for free warehouse delivery slots through the Uzum Seller API in the background and notifies the seller as soon as one appears.

Client
Uzum Market sellers
Industry
E-commerce, logistics
Status
Built
Year
2026

Challenge

Delivering goods to the marketplace warehouse requires a booked slot, and free slots go quickly. Sellers had to keep checking for them by hand.

Solution

The seller registers with their Uzum Seller API token and creates a task with the shop ID and the delivery note number.

A background checker keeps searching for free slots and sends a Telegram message the moment one is found.

Tasks and their status are managed inside the bot.

Result

Sellers no longer watch for slots by hand: the bot does it for them and alerts them at the right moment.

Waiting for slots is the bot’s job.

Uzum Seller API

Works with the official API using the seller’s own token.

Background checks

Free slots are searched continuously.

Multiple tasks

A separate task and status for each delivery note.

Instant alerts

A Telegram notification the moment a slot is found.

Technology

PythonaiogramSQLiteUzum Seller API
